args.description: Game weather sprite, ONE fine fast falling RAIN STREAK centered in16x16canvas. A narrow broken silver blue line only1pixel wide and8pixels long, slight diagonal from upper left to lower right, tapering dim tail above and brighter tiny tip below. Desaturated slate blue-gray, not saturated cyan. Lots of transparent space. Crisp native pixel art, isolated on transparency, no scene or icon outline.

ONE narrow elongated raindrop streak for pixelart weather. Only2pixels wide and11pixels tall in CENTER of16x16transparentcanvas. Falls downward slightly toward right, thin dim broken tail upperleft and bright tiny lower tip. Cool muted silver-gray-blue, restrained contrast, crisp square pixel clusters. No scenery, no ground, no glow, no UI icon. Mostly transparent canvas.

Tiny single raindrop hitting wet stone, a LOW asymmetric pixel splash only10pixels wide and5pixels tall, CENTERED in16x16transparentcanvas. Three fine detached bluegray droplets rebound just above a short horizontal contact fleck. Desaturated silver slate blue with small white highlights. Delicate weather detail, no magical glow, no large waterball, no background. Crisp native pixel art.

Tiny raindrop impact on a shallow puddle, ONE incomplete thin flattened oval ripple10pixels wide and4pixels tall, centered in16x16canvas. Broken muted silver-blue pixel arcs around a transparent empty centre and one tiny raised droplet. Delicate low contrast pixelart weather detail. Isolated transparent background, no solid puddle fill, no terrain, no glow, no portal.
